lines.1: --At lunchtime, the cafeteria was basically a battlefield.
lines.2: The area in front of the shop overflowed with hungry students.
lines.3: Noriko Nishizaki of Class 2-A normally brought lunch, but today she had made the unusual choice of eating at the cafeteria.
lines.11: 「Why are you cutting in? This girl was waiting in line!」
lines.12: 「Huh? Not my problem. There's barely even a line here. It's her fault for spacing out.」
lines.13: 「Don't act like that makes it okay! I can't stand people like you. You make my blood boil.」
lines.15: 「Enough! Go to the back of the line!」
lines.17: 「...I'm pretty sure that boy was from Class 2-C. That class really is hopeless.」
lines.19: 「Noriko, you should at least tell him off too.」
lines.26: 「Sorry, I'm going ahead. My calculations say the fried bread will sell out with ninety-percent probability unless I hurry.」
lines.29: 「Ma'am, I'll have the white bread. Bury it in peanut butter. And soy milk.」
lines.33: 「Still standing there in a daze, Noriko? You charge right in when you're taking pictures, but the rest of the time you're unbelievably slow.」
lines.37: 「A healthy sandwich and pudding. That's fine, right?」
lines.39: 「You don't have to thank me that much. See you.」
lines.43: 「Honestly... I suppose I have no choice.」
